visual_action: A montage of 'man-on-the-street' style interviews with various people in front of the U.S. Capitol building. An off-screen interviewer holds a microphone to them as they answer questions about their recent tax returns. The video concludes with a short, grainy clip of Donald Trump giving a thumbs up.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is mentioned by name multiple times by interviewees crediting his tax policies ("President Trump has instituted some changes"), is the recipient of messages at the end ("what would you say to President Trump?"), and appears in a video clip giving a thumbs up at the end.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: An interviewee contrasts her positive current tax experience with the past, stating, "Under the Biden years, I was screaming every year because I was owing money."

cast.name: unnamed female interviewer
cast.evidence: An unseen woman's voice asks all the interview questions throughout the video, such as "Have you filed your taxes?" and "Did you get more money back or less money back?"

cast.name: unnamed woman with long brown hair
cast.evidence: A woman in a green top and floral skirt who opens and closes the video, saying "Keep the tax cuts coming!"

cast.name: unnamed older couple
cast.evidence: An older man and woman are interviewed together. The woman says her return was "considerably more than last year," and they both offer messages of support for Trump.

cast.name: unnamed man in Star Wars t-shirt
cast.evidence: A man wearing a black Star Wars shirt and red cap says he got "$1,500 more than I expected" back on his taxes.

cast.name: unnamed man in light blue polo shirt
cast.evidence: A man in a baseball cap and sunglasses says what he paid was less than last year, calling it "a win."

cast.name: unnamed woman with dark hair
cast.evidence: A young woman in a white sleeveless top says her return was more than expected and that "money back is nice!"

cast.name: unnamed man in a cowboy hat
cast.evidence: A man in a suit and cowboy hat states, "We're getting more back than compared to last year," crediting child tax credits.

cast.name: unnamed man with graying hair
cast.evidence: A man in a blue patterned shirt says the new tax legislation has been helpful and makes him feel "like we got the right guy in charge."

cast.name: unnamed woman with long black hair
cast.evidence: A woman in a black top says she got close to $1000 back and was "very surprised!"

spoken_summary: An interviewer questions several people in front of the U.S. Capitol about their tax returns. Every person interviewed reports a positive financial outcome, stating they received larger refunds than expected or paid less in taxes than in previous years. Several interviewees explicitly credit "President Trump" and his tax legislation for their financial benefit. One woman contrasts this with owing money "under the Biden years." The interviewees express happiness and surprise, with one man saying it makes him feel "like we got the right guy in charge." The video ends with interviewees sending positive messages to Trump, such as "Keep up the good work" and "Atta boy!"
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of spoken dialogue from interviews. There is no musical soundtrack. Sound effects are used for emphasis: a cash register 'ka-ching' sound plays when people mention getting more money back, a sparkly 'ding' sound plays when a man says his tax situation was "a win," and a loud eagle screech sound effect plays over the final shot of Donald Trump.
editing_pacing: The video is a fast-paced montage with quick cuts between many different interviewees answering questions.
central_claim: Tax policies enacted by Donald Trump are benefiting everyday Americans by giving them larger tax refunds and lower tax bills, in contrast to the policies under the Biden administration.
intended_effect: To convince viewers that Republican tax policies under Trump lead to personal financial gain and to build support for him and his economic agenda.
